quality_policy.estimand: equivalent whole-layer calibration mass (g), not local pressure
quality_policy.comparison_units: All analyzed predictions are in g. Version 4: recorded LINEAR/GAMMA/FIT_PRESS in g, unchanged. Version 3 compatibility: multiply recorded LINEAR/NORM_CAL ratios by the sweep upper load U exactly once; FIT_PRESS already in g.
quality_policy.common_mask: finite RAW, finite two-point endpoints with positive span, all three predictions finite; intersection across all in-range captures and methods
quality_policy.prediction_range_filter: none: finite poor or out-of-range predictions are retained
quality_policy.repeats: n is capture count; independent loading is not inferred from frame or cell count
quality_policy.batch_condition: one module/layer, one load range, one endpoint model, one FIT model and one gamma; model SHA takes priority over copied-file paths
quality_policy.population: spatial cells of per-cell medians across captured frames; spatial SD is not repeatability SD
quality_policy.dispersion: historical CV (%), variance (g squared), IQR (g), MAD (g) plots restored; all metrics use the same mass predictions directly, without Min–Max normalization; spatial SD is additionally reported
quality_policy.repeat_error_bars: sample SD of per-capture metrics when at least two captures exist; n=1 has undefined SD and no error bar
quality_policy.gamma: read from capture provenance; never refitted to validation data
quality_policy.saturation_annotation: legacy 1200/3000 g thresholds are not applied
quality_policy.shared_lut: One inverse LUT from the frozen training mean-cell response, applied independently to each RAW cell before spatial statistics; no validation fitting or RAW averaging before inversion
quality_policy.shared_lut_common_mask: Original LINEAR/GAMMA/FIT_PRESS common mask is unchanged; any nonfinite Shared LUT estimate on this mask aborts analysis

x_axis_policy: Included actual loads with 5% display padding and automatic major ticks; independent of the calibration upper bound

LINEAR.aggregation: one saved complete capture receives one weight; percentage errors exclude zero load

GAMMA.aggregation: one saved complete capture receives one weight; percentage errors exclude zero load

FIT_PRESS.aggregation: one saved complete capture receives one weight; percentage errors exclude zero load

GLOBAL_LUT.aggregation: one saved complete capture receives one weight; percentage errors exclude zero load

zero_load_detail.definition: The four points retain signed mean error at zero load; the adjacent table gives its absolute value in g. No connecting curves, percentage errors or fitted intercepts are added.

model.label: Shared LUT

training_sweep.verification: provenance copied from the hash-verified frozen FIT model; training sweep not reread

model.definition: Average the 256 training RAW ADC values at each load, then apply the same PAVA and inverse-LUT construction; not the mean of 256 inverse functions
model.prediction_rule: Apply the one shared ADC-to-g LUT separately to each validation cell, then clamp predictions to [0,U]; preserve nonfinite RAW as NaN
model.aggregation_rule: Any summary is computed after per-cell prediction, never by predicting the mean validation RAW first

shared_lut_baseline.prediction_order: per-cell inverse LUT, then matched-cell spatial statistics

error_definitions.signed_error_g: mean predicted load minus actual load
